MAN_COLL

Manner of Collision of the First Harmful Event

Release
2024 / accident
Storage type
integer
Measure
categorical
Source
fars-manual-1975-2024, anchor C20

Description

This data element describes the orientation of two motor vehicles in-transport when they are involved in the “First Harmful Event” of a collision crash. If the “First Harmful Event” is not a collision between two motor vehicles in-transport, it is classified as such.

Notes

In the original data files from 1975 to 1977, sideswipe was coded as 5 but has since been changed to 7. These years are not consistent with the documentation of the time. Prior to 2015 the Data Element ID was C19. Prior to 2019 this data element’s name was “Manner of Collision.” This data element also appears in the Vehicle and Person data files and in the Parkwork data file as PMAN_COLL.
